PROJECT 01

SKU Inventory and Warehouse Operations Management

UCI 3PL SKU datasetExcelPower QueryOdooWMS
2,279SKUs analysed
1.67Mrecorded outbound units
979SKUs (43%) with no outbound activity
371SKUs with zero pallet weight

Share of outbound volume by ABC class

A: 274 SKUs80%
B: 240 SKUs15%
C: 1,765 SKUs5%
  • Analysed the SKU data with data cleaning, ABC analysis, PivotTables and KPI reporting, flagging inactive items for seasonal review to optimise warehouse space utilisation and weak pallet data for validation. The 274 A-class SKUs are the priority for tighter stock control.
  • Built an Odoo inventory model covering SKU master, suppliers, warehouse locations, purchase requisition, RFQ, quotation comparison, PO, GRN, stock movements, internal transfers, stock adjustments and replenishment, modelling the stock flow from receipt to dispatch with an automatic reorder rule.
  • Evaluated vendor quotations on price, delivery time and payment terms, then prepared the PO and ran a PO, GRN and invoice three-way match, confirming that ordered, received and billed quantities agreed before payment.
  • Implemented a WMS workflow covering receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and cycle-count reconciliation, keeping physical stock aligned with system records.
  • Built an Excel dashboard to monitor ABC classification, outbound activity, stock KPIs and operational exceptions, giving one view for exception follow-up.

PROJECT 02

E-Commerce Order, Fulfillment and Customer Operations

Olist public datasetExcelZoho InventoryHubSpot CRM
99,441real orders analysed
7,827late orders (7.87% of all orders)
25.68days handover to delivery, late orders
7.89days handover to delivery, on-time orders

Average days from carrier handover to delivery

Late orders25.68
On-time orders7.89
  • Found that late orders took 3.3x longer from carrier handover to delivery, pointing to handover as a likely bottleneck to prioritise for carrier follow-up. This is a pattern in the data, not a proven cause.
  • Built an Excel dashboard with slicers covering delivery KPIs, order status, early and late performance, approval, handover and delivery times, and key operational insights, enabling quick filtering of delays by order status and delivery stage.
  • Implemented an order-to-fulfillment workflow in Zoho Inventory: customer and product records, sales orders, inventory, fulfillment, shipment tracking, returns and exception handling, to track each order from sales order to delivery.
  • Designed HubSpot CRM workflows for customer profiles, order history, segmentation, follow-up, complaints and retention activities, supporting structured post-delivery follow-up.
  • Generated operational documentation including delivery notes, packing lists, invoices and shipment details, with Incoterm recording, supporting clean handover and shipment traceability.
